description.value: Sandman Hotel Vernon is a mid-size chain hotel offering standard and kitchenette rooms with an indoor pool and fitness centre. An on-site Denny's restaurant provides convenient dining, and the hotel has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions for sustainability practices measured against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Pet-friendly rooms and free overnight parking are available, making it a practical overnight stop on a touring route through the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms a real, operating hotel matching the OSM record. Cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools) are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null. Confirmed amenities include: Free Wi-Fi (stated in every room listing and the amenities page), on-site Denny's Restaurant (confirmed for nearby evening food), and USB Charging Ports (listed in the King Bed room features).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active booking website confirming rooms, amenities, and ongoing promotions. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in Vernon.

Nearby evening food.detail: Denny's Restaurant is on-site, listed under both the amenities page and individual room descriptions
